candidates.researchQuestion: After a human-in-the-loop pause, which execution capabilities must be reconstructed from current authority before resumed work can safely continue?
candidates.title: Resume Is More Than Reload: Reconstructing Execution Capability After a Human Pause
candidates.title_zh: 恢复不只是重载状态：人工暂停后的执行能力重建

sections.heading: A paused run can restore history and still be unable to act
sections.heading_zh: 恢复了历史，不等于恢复了行动能力

sections.heading: The missing object was a capability, not a confirmation record
sections.heading_zh: 缺失的不是确认记录，而是执行能力

sections.heading: Split resume into state restoration and capability admission
sections.heading_zh: 把恢复拆成状态恢复与能力准入

sections.heading: Capability drift needs a governed non-execution result
sections.heading_zh: 能力漂移需要明确的受治理不执行结果

sections.heading: One transfer path is not a universal resume theory
sections.heading_zh: 一条转交路径不是通用恢复理论

sections.heading: Which authority should a pending confirmation bind to?
sections.heading_zh: Pending Confirmation 应绑定哪一时刻的权威？

evidenceClaims.claim: The examined resume path reconstructs a dynamically injected transfer capability from current transfer targets before confirmation resolution.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 所检查的恢复路径会在处理确认之前，根据当前 Transfer Target 重建动态注入的 Transfer Capability。

evidenceClaims.claim: When no current transfer target exists, the transfer capability is not reconstructed.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 当前不存在 Transfer Target 时，不会重建该 Transfer Capability。

evidenceClaims.claim: Durable state restoration and current executable-capability restoration should remain separate resume gates.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 持久状态恢复与当前可执行能力恢复应保持为不同的 Resume Gate。

evidenceClaims.claim: A pending confirmation may need an explicit binding to pause-time capability, resume-time capability, or both.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Pending Confirmation 可能需要显式绑定暂停时能力、恢复时能力，或同时绑定两者。

projectRelevance.rationale: The judgment concerns resumable agent execution generally and remains complete without first-party project mapping.

communityEdition.rationale: No named professional community adds a sufficiently distinct discussion angle beyond the complete Research Center analysis.

candidates.researchQuestion: What does a successful session rebind establish—and what does it not establish—after the underlying runtime service changes?
candidates.title: A Reconnected Session Is Not Recovered Work
candidates.title_zh: 会话重新连上，不等于工作已经恢复

sections.heading: A stable session can outlive a failed binding
sections.heading_zh: 稳定 Session 可以跨越失效 Binding

sections.heading: Generation identity draws the epoch boundary
sections.heading_zh: Generation Identity 划出执行纪元

sections.heading: Rebinding restores future availability, not past execution
sections.heading_zh: Rebinding 恢复后续可用性，不恢复过去执行

sections.heading: Recovery needs more than one status
sections.heading_zh: Recovery 不能只有一个状态

sections.heading: What remains unrecovered
sections.heading_zh: 仍然没有恢复的部分

sections.heading: Questions for a durable design
sections.heading_zh: 面向持久设计的开放问题

evidenceClaims.claim: A stable public session can open a replacement gRPC binding after the prior binding stops.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 稳定 Public Session 可以在旧 gRPC Binding 停止后打开 Replacement Binding。

evidenceClaims.claim: Generation-scoped public cell identities prevent stale old-host references from controlling replacement-host cells.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Generation-scoped Public Cell Identity 能阻止旧 Host 的过期引用控制 Replacement Host 的 Cell。

evidenceClaims.claim: Work already running against the previous binding is interrupted rather than transparently migrated.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 旧 Binding 上已经运行的工作会中断，而不是透明迁移。

evidenceClaims.claim: Logical-session continuity and execution continuity should be represented as separate recovery outcomes.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Logical-session Continuity 与 Execution Continuity 应表示为不同的 Recovery Outcome。

projectRelevance.rationale: The argument concerns remote-session recovery architecture generally and remains complete without first-party project mapping.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center analysis already addresses the transferable architecture question without a distinct community-specific edition.

candidates.researchQuestion: How should an extensible tool runtime keep a dynamic local integration bounded and reviewable?
candidates.title: A Dynamic Integration Needs Five Boundaries, Not One Permission Switch
candidates.title_zh: 动态集成需要五条边界，而不是一个许可开关

sections.heading: One feature crosses several trust domains
sections.heading_zh: 一个功能同时跨越多个信任域

sections.heading: Scope: local admission is narrower than configuration presence
sections.heading_zh: Scope：配置存在不等于运行时准入

sections.heading: Ownership: an extension may supplement a protocol without taking it over
sections.heading_zh: Ownership：Extension 可以补充协议，但不能接管协议

sections.heading: Lifetime: caching is a contract, including cached failure
sections.heading_zh: Lifetime：缓存本身就是合同，失败缓存也一样

sections.heading: Resource bounds: cancellation must own the process tree
sections.heading_zh: Resource Bound：Cancellation 必须拥有整个 Process Tree

sections.heading: Observability: show the state without revealing the secret path
sections.heading_zh: Observability：展示状态，但不暴露秘密路径

sections.heading: Five boundaries form one extension contract
sections.heading_zh: 五条边界组成一个 Extension Contract

sections.heading: What the implementation does not establish
sections.heading_zh: 当前实现没有建立什么

sections.heading: Open engineering questions
sections.heading_zh: 仍待回答的工程问题

evidenceClaims.claim: The selected helper is admitted only for local streamable-HTTP MCP configuration and is additionally gated by effective runtime policy.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 所选 Helper 只允许用于本地 Streamable-HTTP MCP Configuration，并继续受到 Effective Runtime Policy 约束。

evidenceClaims.claim: Helper headers are origin-scoped, redirects are stopped, and reserved authentication and protocol headers cannot be claimed.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Helper Header 受到 Origin Scope 约束，Redirect 会停止，且不能占用保留的 Authentication 与 Protocol Header。

evidenceClaims.claim: One provider context shares a bounded cached helper result, including cached failure, with process containment and resource limits.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一个 Provider Context 共享有界 Cached Helper Result，包括失败缓存，并带有 Process Containment 与 Resource Limit。

evidenceClaims.claim: Dynamic local integrations should expose independent scope, ownership, lifetime, resource and observability boundaries.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Dynamic Local Integration 应分别暴露 Scope、Ownership、Lifetime、Resource 与 Observability Boundary。

projectRelevance.rationale: The engineering judgment concerns bounded extension points generally and does not require first-party project mapping.

communityEdition.rationale: No separate community framing adds enough distinct value beyond the complete Research Center engineering insight.
